```yaml
name: Blob Size Policy

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main

jobs:
  update-workflows:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v2

      - name: Update workflow files
        run: |
          sed -i 's|uses: mlugg/setup-zig@v2|uses: mlugg/setup-zig@d1434d08867e3ee9daa34448df10607b98908d29 # v2|' \
               .github/workflows/rust-ci.yml \
               .github/workflows/rust-release.yml \
               .github/workflows/shell-tool-mcp.yml

      - name: Commit changes
        run: |
          git config --global user.name "GitHub Actions"
          git config --global user.email "actions@github.com"
          git add .github/workflows/rust-ci.yml .github/workflows/rust-release.yml .github/workflows/shell-tool-mcp.yml
          git commit -m "Pin setup-zig GitHub Action to immutable SHA"

      - name: Push changes
        uses: ad-m/github-push-action@v0.6.0
        with:
          github_token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          branch: main
```
